programs.title: First Man
programs.desc: The 1960s, the times of the Cold War.The USA and the USSR are engaged in an arms race.The competition also concerns the conquest of space.Test pilot and astronaut Neil Armstrong leads the pioneering Gemini 8 mission, which marks the first-ever docking of two spacecraft in orbit.The test does not go according to plan, as the daredevils lose control of the connected machines.Their lives hang in the balance.However, Neil demonstrates extraordinary skills and self-control, thanks to which he and his companion, David Scott, successfully return to Earth.A year after the tragedy of the Apollo 1 crew, who died during the launch simulation, Armstrong becomes commander of the Apollo 11 mission. It will go down in history.Its goal is to land a man on the Moon.

programs.title: Alita: Battle Angel
programs.desc: Alita (Rosa Salazar), a cyborg girl, wakes up from a coma.It turns out that he doesn't remember who he is or where he is.Doctor Ido (Christoph Waltz) subjected her to a series of tests that revealed that she was a young woman with a unique story.Wanting to protect her, he does not reveal the truth about her past.Alita must adapt to the conditions and rules of life in Scrap City.After some time, he regains his memory thanks to the help of his friend, Hugo (Keean Johnson).Then he realizes that he has incredible fighting skills.She must use them against the power that tries to control her.The film's director is Robert Rodriguez, known from "From Dusk Till Dawn" and "Machete".The script was written by the winner of three Oscars, James Cameron, who considered making "Alita" back in the 1990s. The film was based on the manga.

programs.title: You Gotta Believe
programs.desc: A group of baseball players are having the most important season of their lives.For one of the boys, the stakes are even higher - the team fights not only for victories, but also for his father's dream to come true.

programs.title: How to Train Your Dragon 2
programs.desc: Five years have passed since the truce between the Vikings from the island of Berk and the dragons.The chief's young son, Hiccup, who tamed the first winged creature, Toothless, accidentally ends up with him in an unusual ice cave.There are many wild dragons living there and a mysterious rider who - like the Vikings from Berk - can control fire-breathing creatures.Hiccup is surprised to discover the identity of the mysterious figure... Soon, he learns about the plans of the ruthless Drago, who intends to subdue all dragons.His emissaries organize hunts for them.They also target the winged inhabitants of Berk.Hiccup, Toothless and their friends must fight... Continuation of the fate of the heroes of the first part of the 2010 film.The Polish language version of the film features, among others:Grzegorz Drojewski, Danuta Stenka and Julia Kamińska.

programs.title: The Fountain
programs.desc: Three stories about man's pursuit of immortality.16th century.In the forests of South America, Spanish conquistador Tomas Creo (Hugh Jackman), head over heels in love with Queen Isabella I of Castile (Rachel Weisz), is looking for the legendary tree of life for her.The ruler wants to use them to finally solve the problem of the power struggle with a certain high-ranking cardinal.In the 20th century, scientist Tom Creo (Hugh Jackman) tries to find a cure that will save his seriously ill wife Izzi (Rachel Weisz).A man cannot come to terms with the fact that his beloved is dying.He decides to devote himself to finding a way to overcome death.Six centuries later, astronaut Tommy (Hugh Jackman) travels through space in a glass ball.He wants to reach the golden nebula, hoping to bring Izzi back to life.A science-fiction drama by Darren Aronofsky, author of "Requiem for a Dream", "Black Swan" and "The Wrestler".

programs.title: Blue Moon
programs.desc: The year is 1943. The legendary lyricist Lorenz Hart (Ethan Hawke), co-author of such hits as "Blue Moon" and "My Funny Valentine", spends the night from March 31 to April 1 in Sardi's bar.In the company of friends, including his muse Elizabeth Weiland (Margaret Qualley), he struggles with wounded pride and shaken self-confidence.At this time, his former long-time collaborator Richard Rodgers (Andrew Scott) celebrates the premiere of his musical entitled"Oklahoma!", which he wrote with Oscar Hammerstein II (Simon Delaney).Two Oscar nominations.
